verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents automation rules for handling mail and package shipping/forwarding, plus API/Zapier integration, suggesting some rule-based automation beyond emailing support. However, no evidence details saved recipients, carrier selection, or cost-before-confirm UI specifics for forwarding requests. Missing for 10: saved recipient lists, carrier choice options, cost preview before confirming forwarding, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of the one-click flow.
